hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */install) zsh -n "$f";; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.sh) command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || exit 0; shellcheck -S warning -e SC1091 "$f";; esac; }
